picks.quote: Di Er Nuermaimaiti to win by finish. Bruno Lopes, three of his losses... Di Er Nuermaimaiti, a deadly striker... I'm going knockout as the official pick, but I like the finish prop as the lock
Yair del Valle at minus 700. I know the odds suck, but he should absolutely win.
Ty Miller, minus 350. They're giving him a great matchup here. Billy Ray Goff is a good close-range brawler, but my god, he is going to get past the one-two from Ty Miller? I don't think so.
So I think you got to favor the rising phenom, Alexia Thainara. I think it's positional dominance... Alexia Thainara at minus 250 feels like a pretty good most confident pick.
Mr. Titties himself, Steven Asplund, to get it done... I'm going to favor Stefan Struve to land some big shots... Struve by KO, and I'm feeling pretty damn good about him doing it.
Juliana Miller to win by submission... I think Miller's choking her out. I'm going Miller by sub, pretty confidently.
Manuel Sousa by knockout feels very live... Sousa KO at plus 170... We'll go with Sousa to pull this one out.
I'm going to favor the side of Billy Cornettilo to end up connecting with some big shots... I think he's a live underdog at the plus money plus 145 territory.
Miles Johns by decision at plus 120, taking on Rosas, who's debuting. Johns good at winning these hard-fought decisions... I don't hate that at all.
